summary: Saved patient views stay current, and Patient Tracking opens on the newest referrals.

updates.title: Default Sort by Referral Date
updates.body: Patient Tracking now sorts by latest referral date, newest first.

updates.title: Search by Previous SP Patient ID
updates.body: Patient search now matches previously used specialty pharmacy patient IDs, so patients stay findable after an ID change.

updates.title: CRx Patient ID on Inquiries
updates.body: Inquiry Details now shows the CRx Patient ID as a link to the patient record.

updates.title: Smarter Inquiry Defaults
updates.body: New inquiries now pre-fill Team and Assignee from the patient's most recent referral.

updates.title: Actionable Inquiry Filter
updates.body: The "Actionable Only" filter is now labeled "Actionable Inquiry" for clarity.

updates.title: CRx HCP ID in Directory
updates.body: The HCP Directory now includes a CRx HCP ID column, and search shows exact matches first.

updates.title: HCO Search by ID
updates.body: Fixed searching the HCO Profile by HCO ID so it returns results.

updates.title: HCP Territory in Patient Tracking
updates.body: Fixed Patient Tracking so it shows an updated HCP territory immediately after the change.
